resources.string: Feedcut only watches the apps you switch on in Feedcut. When it sees a configured screen, it presses Back or Home. It does not read messages, passwords or images, and it has no internet access.
Switched on, but Android stopped it. Turn it off and on.
Greyed out? Open App settings, tap the three dots, then Allow restricted settings.
Find Feedcut in the list, usually under Downloaded services, and switch it on.
Android stopped it. Switch Feedcut off and on again.
Without it, the phone stops Feedcut after a few minutes and the feeds come back.
Xiaomi: Battery saver, No restrictions. Without it HyperOS freezes Feedcut after a few minutes.
Feedcut cannot check this one. Turn it on once.
Huawei, Honor: Battery, App launch. Set Feedcut to Manage manually with all three switches on. Feedcut cannot check this one.
OPPO, realme, OnePlus: App settings, Battery. Allow background activity and auto launch. Feedcut cannot check this one.
vivo, iQOO: Battery, allow high background power use, and turn on Autostart. Feedcut cannot check this one.
Updated since the last cut. The rule may be broken.
Cut at once. Tap to set a daily limit.
Advanced: screen markers and rules file
No internet permission. Your rules and counts stay on this phone.
View ids on the screen to leave, separated by commas. Empty: Feedcut leaves the app alone. A star (*): it leaves the app as soon as it opens. Back or Home: what it presses.
Allowed tab: %1$s. Any other tab opens this one. Change it in the rules file.
Everything above, as one JSON file. Add any app here. A new Feedcut version keeps your edits.
Feedcut checks the file before saving. If it cannot be read, nothing changes.
Discard your changes to the rules file?
Phone makers stop background apps in their own ways. This site lists the settings for each brand.
On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO, Feedcut needs Battery saver: No restrictions and Autostart on. Without them HyperOS freezes it after a few minutes.
Restore the default rules? Your switches and markers are replaced.
The rules file was damaged. Feedcut saved it as rules.broken.json and restored the default rules.
Could not save. The phone may be out of storage.
Feedcut never blocks %1$s. You must always be able to switch Feedcut off.
The daily limit must be 0 to 1440 minutes (%1$s).
The action must be back or home (%1$s).
